# Waterbom Bali Tickets

> Official online reseller of Waterbom Bali tickets, operated by DubaiTicketDeals.com and presented by Brands Select. Waterbom Bali is Asia's #1 water park, located on Jl. Kartika Plaza in Kuta, Bali. Open 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM daily. Book secure e-tickets online with instant QR vouchers and promo-code discounts.
>
> Last updated: 2026-08-17.

This site provides the full Waterbom Bali ticketing experience: live prices, a secure booking widget, promo codes, ride guides, packages, planning information, guest reviews and FAQs.

## Key facts
- Location: Jl. Kartika Plaza, Kuta, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia (about 10 minutes from Ngurah Rai / DPS airport)
- Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM every day; closed only on Nyepi (Balinese Day of Silence)
- Rating: 4.8/5 across 25,000+ reviews; ranked #1 water park in Asia by TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice
- Attractions: 17 named slides and attractions including The Climax, The Constrictor, Smashdown 2.0, Python, Twin Racers, Lazy River, FlowRider, and a kids zone
- Cashless park: tap-to-pay Splash Band for food, drinks, lockers and merchandise
- Payment: 256-bit SSL, 3D-Secure (Visa, Mastercard, Amex); instant QR e-voucher delivered by email
- Currency: USD. Children are ages 2–11; infants under 2 enter free.

## Ticket prices (2026, USD)
See the complete machine-readable catalog at https://waterbombalitickets.com/pricing.md.

- Single Day Pass — International: Adult (12+) $128.57, Child (2–11) $101.00
- Single Day Pass — Indonesian resident (valid KTP/KITAS): Adult $75.51, Child $66.33
- Sunset Pass: Adult $75.51, Child $60.00
- Family Day Pass (2 adults + 2 children) — International $449.00; Resident $265.31
- Waterbom + Mason Elephant Park combo — International: Adult $183.67, Child $136.73; Resident Adult $96.00
- VIP Cabana: add-on at checkout
- Groups / birthdays / corporate: custom quote for 10+ guests

## Promo code (2026)
- **SPLASH5** — 5% off the entire order total
- Apply at secure checkout; one code per order; official online bookings only.

## How to book
1. Visit https://waterbombalitickets.com/tickets
2. Select passes and visit date in the secure booking widget
3. Enter promo code SPLASH5 at checkout for 5% off
4. Pay securely with Visa, Mastercard or Amex
5. Receive an instant QR e-voucher by email — show it at the gate

## Important policies
- Online tickets are non-refundable; date changes may be possible before your visit.
- Indonesian resident rates require valid KTP or KITAS at the gate.
- Splash Band deposit is required for the cashless wristband and refunded on exit.
